name: Twelfth
description: Hosted MCP server for Twelfth, a commercial workspace for retail and category teams. Reads the products, suppliers, sales, inventory, pricing, projects, members and actions the signed-in person can access in one workspace. Reads by default; with Allow changes ticked at consent it can also create, complete or snooze the person's own actions and run their own routines. Needs a Twelfth account.
